title: Semantic model
description: A modelled table or view. Methodology-neutral core; pack-specific detail in attributes.

methodology.description: Pack id: direct, kimball, dv2, obt, activity-schema, property-graph.

role.description: Legal roles are supplied by the active pack's methodology.yaml.

grain_statement.description: Plain-language grain. Copied from the TDD, which derived it from the BRD.

grain_columns.description: Generates the uniqueness assertion. Every methodology needs this.

grain_checksum.description: Hash of the TDD grain declaration. Divergence fails the build.

attributes.description: Pack-scoped: scd_type, fact_type, dim_refs, additivity for Kimball; nesting for direct.

brd_requirement_id.description: BRD requirement IDs this artefact satisfies. Empty = orphan design, fails G1.
